edenOS / AppDev INSTALL, TEST & RELEASE STRATEGY — v1.1

INSTALL PROFILES: INSTALL / RECOMMENDED — balanced, device-aware; reuse
adequate existing capability. LEAN — minimum essentials. FULL — all
appropriate supported capabilities, avoiding pointless duplication.
CUSTOM — explicit user control.

BOOTSTRAP: UNPACK → VERIFY → DETECT EXISTING EDEN/INSTALL → DISCOVER
EXISTING SUITABLE CAPABILITIES → BACKUP/STAGE → TRANSACTIONAL
INSTALL/UPDATE → PRESERVE STATE → VERIFY → ATOMIC COMMIT → LAUNCH
INSTALLED COPY → HEALTH CHECK → OPEN UI → RETURN TERMINAL CONTROL.

UPDATE: CHECK → DOWNLOAD/STAGE → VERIFY → BACKUP → UPDATE →
TEST/REGRESSION → COMMIT → ROLLBACK TO LAST KNOWN GOOD ON FAILURE.

RELEASE RINGS: LUCAS / PRIVATE → FAMILY & FRIENDS → ALPHA → PREVIEW →
FINAL / PUBLIC.

Promotion is evidence-based, not calendar-based.

Family & Friends inherits the Family interaction preference: calm,
gentle, supportive, clear, recovery-oriented. This never hides real
failures, warnings or safety consequences.

AI / EXECUTION: DETERMINISTIC/EXISTING → TINY → LOCAL → LAN/SHARED →
EXTERNAL API → HYBRID. Use the lowest sufficient capability.
